title: Shared-host turns
current: Each Test Machine keeps one FIFO waiting line (qa_host_waits). A scoped QA plan execution that cannot lease the host and a refused manual QA_HOST:<machine> acquire both join it. Every release of the host, including yoke claims work release by claim id, reserves it for the oldest live waiter and wakes that session; the waiter's next acquire consumes the turn. Session end, execution settlement and releasing an unused reservation cancel the wait. The claim_held refusal names the session's place in line, the holder's own release command and the steering-seat recovery.
desired: Live proof on a registered test host: a manual acquire refused behind a plan execution is reserved and woken on release, then takes the turn.
